lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spacing between centroids increases significantly as the pattern extends towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot centroids, creating a visible lattice-like grid along the lateral line area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient showing light on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small elongated organism, consistent with the morphology of a remora, is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
